name: octocode-agent-monorepo
description: Octocode agent monorepo — the branded agent launcher, the Pi harness extension, and the Awareness coordination layer.
author: Guy Bary <bgauryy@octocodeai.com>

scripts.test:production-conformance: node --input-type=module -e "import { spawnSync } from 'node:child_process'; const result = spawnSync(process.execPath, ['node_modules/vitest/vitest.mjs', 'run', 'packages/octocode-agent-testing/tests/production-host-conformance.test.ts'], { stdio: 'inherit', env: { ...process.env, OCTOCODE_AGENT_REQUIRE_PRODUCTION_CONFORMANCE: '1' } }); process.exit(result.status ?? 1);"
scripts.test:rust-integration: cargo build --locked --manifest-path packages/octocode-agent-core-rust/Cargo.toml --bins && cargo build --release --locked --manifest-path packages/octocode-agent-core-rust/Cargo.toml --bins && node --input-type=module -e "import { existsSync } from 'node:fs'; import { resolve } from 'node:path'; if (process.platform === 'win32') throw new Error('Real Rust integration tests do not yet resolve Windows .exe paths; refusing to skip the release gate'); for (const relativeFile of ['debug/octocode-agent-core-rust', 'debug/octocode-agent-fs', 'release/octocode-agent-core-rust']) { const file = resolve('packages/octocode-agent-core-rust/target', relativeFile); if (!existsSync(file)) throw new Error('Required Rust integration binary is unavailable: ' + file); }" && node node_modules/vitest/vitest.mjs run packages/octocode-agent/tests/native-rust-core.test.ts packages/octocode-agent/tests/native-rust-runtime.test.ts packages/octocode-agent/tests/native-rust-file-system.test.ts packages/octocode-agent/tests/native-rust-worker-messages.test.ts --maxWorkers=1
scripts.typecheck: yarn workspaces foreach -At run typecheck && yarn workspace octocode-agent typecheck:tests
scripts.verify: yarn lint && yarn typecheck && yarn test && yarn test:rust-integration && yarn test:ffi && yarn build && yarn test:pack && yarn test:production-conformance && yarn test:pty && yarn test:pty:stream && yarn test:pty:signals && yarn test:performance:guarded
